title: Packages marked delivered but not received by customers
situation: High volume of reports regarding missing packages marked as delivered, requiring immediate investigation to maintain trust.
hypothesis: Packages left with incorrect neighbors or reception

params.reply_en: I am sorry your package is missing despite the delivered status. I have opened an investigation with our carrier to locate your order and will update you within 24 hours.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن عدم استلام شحنتك رغم ظهورها كـ "تم التوصيل". لقد بدأت تحقيقاً مع شركة الشحن لتحديد موقع طلبك وسأوافيك بالتحديثات خلال 24 ساعة.

actions.why: Acknowledge the issue and set clear expectations for resolution.

params.note: Cluster of 22 reports where packages are marked delivered but missing; potential carrier misdelivery issue.

actions.why: Escalate to logistics to investigate the specific carrier route or driver behavior.

actions.title: Package marked delivered but not received
actions.answer_en: If your order shows as delivered but you haven't received it, please check with neighbors or your building reception first. If still missing, contact us so we can investigate with the carrier.
actions.answer_ar: إذا ظهر طلبك كـ "تم التوصيل" ولم تستلمه، يرجى التحقق من الجيران أو مكتب الاستقبال أولاً. إذا لم تجده، تواصل معنا لنقوم بالتحقيق مع شركة الشحن.

reply_en: I am sorry your package is missing despite the delivered status. I have opened an investigation with our carrier to locate your order and will update you within 24 hours.
reply_ar: نعتذر عن عدم استلام شحنتك رغم ظهورها كـ "تم التوصيل". لقد بدأت تحقيقاً مع شركة الشحن لتحديد موقع طلبك وسأوافيك بالتحديثات خلال 24 ساعة.

reply_other.es: Lamento que su paquete no haya llegado a pesar de aparecer como entregado. He abierto una investigación con el transportista para localizar su pedido y le informaré en un plazo de 24 horas.
reply_other.fr: Je suis désolé que votre colis soit manquant malgré le statut livré. J'ai ouvert une enquête auprès de notre transporteur pour localiser votre commande et je vous tiendrai informé sous 24 heures.

alternatives.why: Some customers explicitly accuse the driver of lying about delivery.

alternatives.hypothesis: System sync delay between carrier and store
alternatives.why: Status might update prematurely in our system before physical delivery.
